requirements.text: SeminarSchedulingSystem is a class in the SeminarSchedulingSystem package
Presenter is a class in the SeminarSchedulingSystem package
Seminar is a class in the SeminarSchedulingSystem package. It has an attribute named "title" of type "String"
The scheduling system has an offering that could be cancelled.
Date is a class of SeminarSchedulingSystem package. It has two attributes: year of type Integer and day of type Integer
Attendee is a class which belongs to SeminarSchedulingSystem package. It has an attribute named "name" of type "String"
A Seminar Scheduling System is associated to 0 or several Presenters
A Presenter is associated to one and only one Seminar Scheduling System
A Presenter has 0 or several Offerings
A Seminar is associated to one and only one Seminar Scheduling System
Seminar is associated to 0 or several Offerings
Offering is associated to one and only one Date
A relationship between the presenter of a scheduled seminar and offering of a seminar
The name of the attendees that are going to attend the offered seminar
